ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Live fixture for issue #86. Ships a C# assembly defining a custom def subclass `JoofTest.GadgetDef : Def` and nothing else -- no XML instances of its own. Present in Run A, REMOVED before Run B (a pure mod-list change, same toggle as joof.testharness.gate for --expect-mayrequire). TestMod_TypeConsumer's unconditional, unpatched <JoofTest.GadgetDef> instances must be dirtied by the removal even though TestMod_TypeConsumer itself never changed, has no patches touching these defs, and no MayRequire anywhere -- because the .NET Type this mod supplied no longer exists once it's gone. This is the real oppey.eyegenes2 / nals.facialanimation shape (FacialAnimation.EyeballColorDef), reproduced with a throwaway type. No game content — dev/QA use only.
